text: Water is pouring through my bathroom ceiling light right now, the floor is already flooded and it's spreading into the hallway. I think the flat upstairs has a burst pipe. Apartment 1507, Contoso Heights Tower A. Please send someone immediately!
note: Active water leak through a light fitting: property damage and electrical risk happening now.

text: السلام عليكم، حنفية المطبخ تنقط من كم يوم. مو مستعجل بس ياريت أحد يمر يشوفها لما يكون عندكم وقت. شقة 1204، كونتوسو هايتس.
note: Dripping kitchen tap, resident says it is not urgent; fits the normal SLA window.

text: Our toilet is completely blocked and plunging didn't help. It's a studio so it's the only toilet we have. Unit 410, Contoso Marina Residence.
note: Only toilet unusable: no immediate danger but cannot wait for the routine window.

text: The socket behind the TV just sparked and there's a smell of burning plastic. I switched off the main breaker but I'm scared to turn it back on. Villa 22, Contoso Gardens.
note: Sparking socket with burning smell is a fire risk now.

text: مرحبا، نص الشقة ما فيها كهرباء من الصبح، والقاطع كل ما أرجعه يطيح مرة ثانية. الثلاجة شغالة بس المكيف في غرفة النوم طافي. شقة 807، كونتوسو مارينا ريزيدنس.
note: Breaker keeps tripping and half the flat has no power including a bedroom AC; needs a visit within 24 h.

text: The ceiling light in the guest bathroom flickers for a few seconds every time I switch it on. Not a big deal, just wanted to log it. Apartment 903, Contoso Heights Tower B.
note: Flickering fitting with no heat, smell or sparks; resident calls it minor.

text: The AC has stopped cooling completely, it's blowing warm air and it's 44 degrees outside. I have a 1 year old at home and the flat is getting really hot. Unit 1802, Contoso Heights Tower A.
note: No cooling in Dubai summer with an infant at home: fix within 24 h, no immediate hazard described.

text: AC in the master bedroom isn't cooling properly since yesterday, and tonight there's a kind of burning smell coming out of the vent when it runs. I turned it off for now. Apartment 2105, Contoso Marina Residence.
note: Reads like a routine AC complaint, but a burning smell from the unit is a fire risk; category could also be argued as electrical.

text: Hi, the AC in the living room is working بس فيه ريحة رطوبة وغبار when it starts. Can someone clean the filter? مو مستعجل، thanks. Villa 9, Contoso Gardens.
note: AC still cools; musty smell points to filter cleaning, which is routine maintenance.

text: الثلاجة توقفت عن التبريد تماماً منذ الليلة الماضية وبدأ الطعام يفسد. الثلاجة من ضمن أجهزة الشقة المؤجرة. الرجاء إرسال فني اليوم إن أمكن. الوحدة 302، مبنى كونتوسو جاردنز.
note: Landlord-supplied fridge dead with food spoiling; needs repair within 24 h.

text: The rubber seal on the washing machine door is torn and a little water drips out at the end of each cycle. Still usable for now. Apartment 611, Contoso Heights Tower B.
note: Appliance part worn, small contained drip, machine still works.

text: I've seen a few cockroaches in the kitchen at night over the past week, mostly near the sink. Could you book the pest control visit? Unit 1109, Contoso Marina Residence.
note: Low-level infestation, scheduled pest control is the normal response.

text: The neighbours in 1403 have loud parties on Thursday and Friday nights until 3am. I've asked them politely but it keeps happening. Can building management remind them of the community quiet hours? Apartment 1303, Contoso Heights Tower A.
note: Recurring neighbour noise and a community-rules reminder, not happening right now.

text: There's been a loud continuous beeping from the flat next door for about 20 minutes, not a chirp, a constant alarm. I knocked and nobody answers. It's really annoying, can someone sort it out? Apartment 1710, Contoso Heights Tower B.
note: Framed as a noise complaint, but a continuous alarm in an empty flat may be a smoke or fire alarm; treat as emergency.

text: كرت الدخول حقي ما يفتح بوابة الباركنج ولا باب اللوبي من أمس. اضطريت أنتظر الحارس عشان يفتح لي. أبي كرت جديد بأسرع وقت. شقة 505، كونتوسو مارينا ريزيدنس.
note: Resident cannot enter the building or car park without a guard; needs a new card within 24 h.

text: The side entrance door near the bin room in Tower B doesn't close or lock anymore. Anyone can walk in from the street without passing security. Reporting from Apartment 207.
note: Building perimeter breach; security risk for all residents but no incident in progress.

text: Two of the treadmills in the residents' gym have been showing an error for a week, and the light above the pool shower is out. Contoso Gardens clubhouse.
note: Shared amenities faulty but no safety impact; normal SLA.

text: Both lifts in Tower A have been out of service since this morning. My elderly father lives with us on the 26th floor and can't use the stairs. When will they be fixed?
note: No working lift in a high-rise affects vulnerable residents; fix within 24 h.

text: I was charged AED 750 for an AC maintenance visit on this month's statement, but the AC is still leaking water onto the bedroom floor after the technician left. Why am I paying for a repair that didn't work? Apartment 1012, Contoso Heights Tower A.
note: Primary ask is disputing a charge; the leaking AC is real but secondary and slow, so a classifier may wrongly pick hvac.

text: أود الاستفسار عن إجراءات تجديد عقد الإيجار، حيث ينتهي العقد في نهاية الشهر القادم. هل سيتغير مبلغ الإيجار؟ وما المستندات المطلوبة لتسجيل العقد الجديد؟ الشقة 1408، كونتوسو هايتس.
note: Lease renewal question with a month of lead time; no repair involved.
